summary: Copies the source string a1 into the output buffer lpSrcStr, stripping every double-quote character (0x22 = 34), then null-terminates the result and returns the outcome of sub_589901(lpSrcStr). The write index v2 only advances for copied characters, so the output is the quote-free, compacted string.

operations.description: Initialize the output write index v2 to 0.
Iterate over source characters i from 0 to strlen(a1) - 1.
Skip the current character when it equals the double-quote literal 34 (0x22); it is not copied.
Copy each non-quote source character into lpSrcStr at the advancing index v2.
Call sub_589901(lpSrcStr) with the stripped string and propagate its return value.

unresolved: Purpose of sub_589901 (result likely consumed by the PitCrewAnimationLoader caller).
The prototype names the destination LPCSTR but it is written to, so the true type is a mutable char buffer.
